levels.surface: أحمد بن محمد بن سعيد بن عقدة
محمد بن أحمد بن نصر التيمي

notes: RULING: the second saying («فقال يحيى بن الحسن لحرب ... قال: سألت يحيى بن المساور عن ذلك») has its own transmission (Harb asked Yahya b. al-Musawir); it is not in this group: needs a ruling
RULING: the Imam Musa speaks and acts inside the narrated encounter of Ali b. Abi Hamza's account (rule 11): the chain ends at علي بن أبي حمزة, whose words are the saying
«يحدث يحيى بن الحسن العلوي أن ...» reads Yahya b. al-Hasan as the addressee of Harb's narration, not a link; THQ's English reads him as a transmitter (see fixes)

fixes.reason: The text makes Yahya b. al-Hasan the addressee of Harb's narration, while THQ's English gives him as a transmitter of the tradition about Yahya b. al-Musawir.

evidence.quote: يحدث يحيى بن الحسن العلوي أن يحيى بن المساور قال
Yahya bin Hasan Alawi has narrated a tradition that Yahya bin Masawar said
